method.authority: The GGUF tensor index and the resident exact decode graph.
method.included: Every blk.N {attn_q,attn_k,attn_v,attn_output,ffn_gate,ffn_up,ffn_down}.weight projection and the full output.weight projection.
method.excluded: Embedding row lookup, norms, RoPE, attention/KV state, activation I/O, quant metadata already inside tensor byte ranges, command overhead, and all rereads. Exclusions make this a lower bound on device traffic.

measured_current_model.interpretation: The value divides only the active-weight lower bound by complete-token time. Real traffic and total latency are higher because the excluded work is nonzero.

bandwidth_constant.scope: An imported Apple M3 Ultra read-bandwidth ceiling for a necessary-condition calculation, not a current Llama kernel throughput result.

conclusion.same_model_exact_decode: A command-topology or geometry-only change cannot remove this unique per-token weight set. It may close the 394 GiB/s effective gap, but the 736 GB/s necessary-condition ceiling is below TG5 even before KV, activation, or synchronization costs.
conclusion.tg1_route: TG1 requires a format-native representation that materially lowers active bytes (and likely executed work) while establishing artifact-specific quality/parity. It cannot be claimed from this GGUF's exact continuation lane.
conclusion.next_bounded_work: Use a Llama Gravity artifact or an equivalent executable format with a declared active-byte ledger and token/logit quality gate; do not promote raw adapter receipts or smaller models as a base-TPS win.
